name: Buildium
description: Buildium is cloud-based property management software offering accounting, online rent collection, maintenance and work-order management, tenant screening, e-signature leasing, and a resident portal, aimed at residential, multifamily, community-association, and mixed-use property managers.
best_for: Property managers who want published, predictable tiered pricing rather than a custom quote, and a lower entry cost than AppFolio.
features: Online rent collection and payment processing

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.notes: Starting price; core accounting, leasing, and maintenance features.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Marked "Most Popular" on the official pricing page.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Adds open API access and the fullest feature set.

pros: Published, predictable tiered pricing — rare in property-management software
Real, directly observed usage among property managers, including at scale (1,150+ units on one plan disclosed directly)
Real, active consumer affiliate program (25% commission via Impact Radius, 30-day cookie)
cons: Fewer enterprise-scale customization options than AppFolio at the top tier
Premium tier's $400/month starting price is a large jump from Growth
AI-integration interest observed among its own user base suggests some feature gaps buyers are actively looking to fill

faq.question: How much does Buildium cost?
faq.answer: Buildium publishes three tiers: Essential from $62/month, Growth from $192/month, and Premium from $400/month, each with a 14-day free trial and no credit card required to start.

faq.question: Does Buildium have an affiliate program?
faq.answer: Yes — Buildium runs a consumer affiliate program on the Impact Radius network paying 25% commission with a 30-day cookie window, separate from its customer-referral program (up to $400 in account credit per referral).

alternatives.name: AppFolio
alternatives.description: Established, feature-rich property management platform with custom-quoted pricing.
alternatives.best_for: Larger portfolios and operators who want a deeply established platform and don't need public pricing
